title: AgentStep Loop Against Live Ollama
description: Same AgentStep validation but with call_model talking to a live Ollama instance on localhost:11434; schema sent in format parameter constrains decoding.

steps.description: Purpose: P7 runs against a live Ollama instance on localhost:11434.
AgentStep model: same validation as fake model version.
Tools: days_until and calculator functions identical to fake model version.
SYSTEM prompt: instructs model to produce one step as JSON with constraints.
Call_model: posts to localhost:11434/api/chat with schema in format parameter for constrained decoding.
Run_agent: same loop as fake model but calls live Ollama, validates responses, executes tools.
Main: runs agent with study hours question when executed as script.
